title: Activation funnel
definition: M23 definition v1. Cohort: non-excluded workspaces created in the interval whose 14-day window has matured by asOf (immature workspaces are counted in measures.immature, never in a step). Steps, each counted independently within 14 days of creation: workspace_created (cohort anchor), channel_connected, voice_activated, draft_created, draft_approved, post_scheduled, publish_verified. value = workspaces that reached the step; coverage numerator/denominator = reached / matured cohort (or / workspaces the taxonomy observed for steps without a proxy); measures name the source ('taxonomy', 'transition_proxy', 'taxonomy+transition_proxy'), the proxy, rate, dropFromPrevious and stuckFromPrevious (reached the previous step but not this one).
source_contract: pr_workspaces.created_at (business_workspace_starts) + pr_product_events §8.6 taxonomy (business_product_events) + transition proxies: pr_audit_events channel.connected (business_channel_audit), pr_learning_events draft.approved/post.published with their daily rollup (business_learning_events, business_learning_rollups), pr_notification_events publish.verified
limitations: Registration is not success. Transition proxies are lower bounds (learning events are not written while a workspace turns learning off), so proxy-based steps are partial. voice_activated, draft_created and post_scheduled have no proxy: until the taxonomy has observed a whole cohort they report only the workspaces created after it began collecting (collectingSince) and the rest as unknown, never as not reached. Steps are counted independently, not in order: a Quick start draft can come before a channel connection.

title: Time to first value
definition: Median seconds from workspace creation to its first value event within 14 days (the first Time Back draft or publish row, or the first verified publication: taxonomy publish.verified, publish notifications or learning post.published), among non-excluded workspaces created in the interval whose 14-day window has matured. measures: n (workspaces with a first value), noFirstValue (censored at 14 days), quartiles, immature and which source supplied each first value; coverage numerator/denominator = n / matured cohort.
source_contract: pr_workspaces.created_at + pr_time_savings_ledger (business_time_savings) + pr_product_events publish.verified + pr_notification_events publish.verified + pr_learning_events post.published (with rollup)
limitations: The median describes workspaces that reached value within 14 days; the rest are reported as noFirstValue, not folded into the median. No first value in a matured cohort is not_applicable, never zero seconds.

title: Feature adoption
definition: Per feature: active non-excluded workspaces that used it in the interval / workspaces active in the interval (activity definition v1: completed or applied agent runs, publish outcomes, person-initiated taxonomy events). Features: voice, brand, write_like_me (draft.created voice=personalized), quick_start, agent_drafting, review (proxy learning draft.approved), scheduling, publishing (proxies: publish notifications, learning post.published), campaigns, automations, suggestions (accepted), research, humanizer, weekly_operator.
limitations: Eligibility is activity in the interval; plan entitlements are not modelled in v1. A feature whose taxonomy began collecting after the interval start is partial (collectingSince); one never recorded is not_instrumented. Adoption is not causation.

title: Weekly retention cohorts
definition: Cohort = non-excluded workspaces created in a local calendar week (Monday start, report time zone) within the interval. Cell (cohort, week k = 0..12) = workspaces of the cohort active (activity definition v1) during local calendar week cohort+k / cohort size, observed through asOf. Only matured cells (the whole week k has ended) carry a value with numerator/denominator; unmatured cells are returned as not_applicable with reason cell_not_matured.
limitations: insufficient_history until 56 days (8 matured weeks) separate the earliest workspace from asOf. Week 0 is the partial signup week. Automation-run activity counts as activity (active_workspaces v1). No comparison period.

title: Time back
definition: Sum of saved_seconds from the Time Back ledger in the interval for non-excluded workspaces, always grouped by confidence (measured, personalized, estimated); never merged into one number.
limitations: Estimated and personalized rows are baselines, not measurements; only measured rows include Raffi active time. Ledger rows exist only from the Time Back release.

title: Retention correlations (hypothesis)
definition: P2 hypothesis. Population: non-excluded workspaces created in the interval at least 56 days before asOf (and, for a feature without a transition proxy, after its taxonomy began collecting). Adopter = used the feature within 14 days of creation; retained = active (activity definition v1) in days 28-56 (weeks 4-7). value = retained share among adopters; measures carry basis='hypothesis', adopters, nonAdopters, both retained counts, nonAdopterShare and difference.
source_contract: pr_workspaces.created_at + pr_product_events + pr_agent_runs + pr_notification_events + pr_learning_events (with rollup)
limitations: Correlation, not causation: adopters may differ in intent. Groups under 10 workspaces are suppressed. insufficient_history until 8 matured weeks exist overall, and per feature until its taxonomy has collected for 56 days.
